title: ZILFIT Pre-Print Manufacturing Manifest V1
description: Engineering manufacturing authority document. Not a production release. Not a medical, therapeutic, or clinical specification.
wall_thresholds_notes: Pre-print engineering target values only — NOT runtime-enforced guarantees.
Runtime density-to-wall coordination is deferred to future pipeline integration work and is not implemented in the current codebase.
Wall thresholds are verified during coupon validation (CT-02 Wall Thickness Effect), not guaranteed by current runtime geometry generation.
Current simulation and compression evidence is calibrated for TPU 75A-80A. Any material hardness change invalidates existing simulation evidence.
partner_notes: Contact established per reports/ZILFIT_AMFUTURE_HANDOFF.md. No production file pack delivered. No printability confirmation received.

primary_process.rationale: MJF is the only process validated in pipeline. MJF min wall 0.6 mm confirmed per P01_BALANCE_READINESS_REPORT.md. Printability score 92%.

SLS.deferral_rationale: SLS min wall 0.7 mm exceeds several zone thresholds (toe 0.6 mm, forefoot 0.6 mm). No SLS-specific material profile exists. SLS process capability not validated in pipeline. Must be explicitly re-evaluated and approved via separate engineering gate before authorizing.

scan_to_print.rationale: Current pipeline operates entirely in validation_status: simulation. No physical print evidence, no fabrication partner printability confirmation, no full 15-zone density map submitted for fabrication review, no as-built dimensional inspection exists. Per docs/SCAN_FOOT_PREPRODUCTION_READINESS_SUMMARY_V1.md, pipeline is Not Coupon-Ready, Not Physical Prototype-Ready, Not Manufacturing-Ready. Scan-to-print automation requires completion of COUPON-PRINT, COUPON-TEST, COUPON-VALIDATE, PRINT-REVIEW, EXT-REVIEW, and PROTO-AUTH gates.

sensor_housing.rationale: No sensor housing geometry exists in current CAD pipeline. No embedded electronics design. No IPX rating requirement defined. Must be separately scoped and gated.

livefit_camera_ux.rationale: LiveFit camera UX is a scan input UX — not a manufacturing pipeline component. Its outputs are engineering handoff JSONs that feed into the density pipeline. The scan UX itself does not produce print-ready geometry and is not blocked.

gate_0_stl_fingerprint.name: STL Fingerprint Verification
gate_0_stl_fingerprint.description: Every STL submitted for print must carry a computed fingerprint (hash) registered in manifest. Fingerprint mismatch or absence → HOLD.

gate_1_mesh_validation.name: Mesh Validation
gate_1_mesh_validation.description: Every mesh must pass manifold check, closed-shell check, no degenerate triangles, no non-manifold edges, no inverted normals, and within printability constraints per runtime mesh contract.

gate_2_density_jump_cap.name: Adjacent Zone Density Jump Cap
gate_2_density_jump_cap.description: No adjacent zone density jump may exceed 15 pct. If exceeded, density smoothing must intervene before wall thickness assignment. No zone output record may proceed with unresolved jump violation.

gate_3_pressure_coupon.name: Pressure/Compression Coupon Test
gate_3_pressure_coupon.description: CT-01 Compression stiffness pass, CT-02 Wall thickness effect pass, CT-04 Compression set pass per docs/COUPON_TEST_READINESS_PLAN_V1.md.

gate_4_flex_coupon.name: Flexural Coupon Test
gate_4_flex_coupon.description: CT-03 Rebound pass, CT-05 Inter-zone transition pass. Gyroid flexural behavior validated per reports/ZILFIT_MECHANICAL_VALIDATION_PLAN.md.

gate_5_fatigue_coupon.name: Fatigue Coupon Test
gate_5_fatigue_coupon.description: CT-04 Extended fatigue cycling pass (10,000 cycles, no fracture, < 5% permanent deformation). S-N curve approximation validated against physical TPU 75A-80A coupon data.

gate_6_c7_human_comfort.name: C7 Human Comfort Validation
gate_6_c7_human_comfort.description: Multi-wearer comfort assessment with documented pressure point, instability, and discomfort data. Wear trial protocol per Phase 3 of reports/ZILFIT_AMFUTURE_HANDOFF.md.

holds.description: Full sole print not authorized. Only coupon-scale prints (per coupon_test_matrix_v1.json) permitted until coupon gates 3–5 are passed AND STL fingerprint + mesh validation are verified.

Batch printing multiple editions in a single production run not authorized. Single-edition, single-unit pilot required first. Process capability for edition-specific geometry variance not yet established.
holds.unblock_condition: single edition pilot print passed and reviewed

holds.description: Fully automated scan-to-print pipeline is BLOCKED at pre-print gate. Individual STL generation and manual print handoff may proceed after all preprint gates pass, but automated pipeline release requires additional governance approval.
holds.unblock_condition: explicit governance approval after full gate chain cleared

holds.description: No sensor housing CAD, electronics design, or IPX rating exists. Not scoped for P0/P1.
holds.unblock_condition: separate product scope definition and engineering gate

holds.description: Outsole-to-insole bonding process not defined. No adhesive or mechanical bonding specification exists. No peel test data. Not scoped for first-print pilot.

Complete AMFuture production file pack (STL + manufacturing metadata JSON + print sheet + material spec) not yet assembled. Per reports/ZILFIT_AMFUTURE_HANDOFF.md, digital verification (Phase 1) not yet complete.
holds.unblock_condition: full file pack assembled and reviewed per AMFuture handoff checklist
